literal_meaning: সীমান্তমুদ্রা বা অল্প জমির পরিমাণ (ছোটখাটো জমির ইঙ্গিত)
figurative_meaning_en: at most, at the very utmost
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কাছে হদ্দমুদ্দ দশটা টাকা আছে।
এই গাঁয়ে হদ্দমুদ্দ কয়েক বিঘা জমি পাওয়া যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He has at most ten rupees with him.
In this village, you can get at most a few bighas of land.
history: This idiom originates from traditional Bengali land measurement practices, where 'hadd' refers to boundaries and 'mudd' implies a small handful or measure, reflecting agrarian socio-economic contexts in rural Bengal.
note: The term is dialectal and commonly used in eastern Bengal regions to downplay small possessions.
